title: MIP Session Issuance Response (bearer transport)
description: Flow A's /verify success body (§7.1), and §9's refresh success for the native/bearer case (identical minus 'principal', which the Client already holds). Cookie-transport successes (Flow B /callback, browser refresh) carry no body-level token fields — see §7.1 — and are not covered by this schema.

refresh_token.description: MUST be present if the RP supports §9, MUST be absent otherwise.

principal.description: REQUIRED for Flow A's /verify success. Absent on a §9 refresh response — the Client already holds it from the original verification.
